[spoiler=The Withdrawal]
Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Luigi Mario recognizes the claim of Yulandburg on Zuiden Island
---------------------------
Today, Luigi Mario, Brother of Mario Mario and Vice President, has announced that Imperium Romae Marii will end its dispute on Zuiden Island by recognizing it as part of the Yussrian Commonwealth Empire of Yulandburg.

Luigi Mario has also announced that the Government has decided to withdraw the Navy from Zuiden on April 25th, and will also drop its future Colonial Ambitions, especially those in Vespurias and the 2 poles.

According to him, the Government and Mario Mario himself have decided to withdraw claims and ambitions to "reduce outside tensions and avoid the situation from becoming worse."

However, critics warn that this decision will heighten internal tensions, as this decision will sound to many like the government becoming weak and useless.
[/spoiler]

[i]And...[/i]

[spoiler=The Fire]

Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Construction on the Memorial Site in Yoshiland Halted Due to Mass Burning
---------------------------

During the construction of the Yoshiland Massacre Memorial site, which was mandated following international pressure from the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya, approximately 20,000 masked and unidentified men and women stormed the site and set it on fire.

The attackers reportedly burned construction materials, equipment, and the bodies of victims from the April 12th incident that were both buried and not yet buried.

Due to international pressure, the Romariian Military was not deployed to avoid redoing the April 12th Incident and international condemnation.

Witnesses and surviving workers claim that during the attack, many of the individuals were shouting slogans and distributing messages calling on the population to reject the ultimatum issued by Wuloosya and rise up. Chants such as No foreign control, Romariia will not kneel, and This government is becoming a puppet were reportedly heard throughout the area.

Some witnesses have also reported the presence of religious imagery and language among the attackers, though it remains unclear whether this indicates affiliation with any specific organized group.

Authorities have not yet identified the group responsible for organizing the attack, with some experts suspecting Muslims to have planned the fire due to recent data indicating most Muslims are against Animists; these claims, however, are unverified and do not have any strong evidence.

The construction of the memorial has been indefinitely halted following the incident.

This event marks a further escalation in tensions, as opposition to both the ultimatum and the government's compliance appears to be growing more aggressive.
[/spoiler]

The Neue Republik condemns the actions of the IRM, including the use of chemical weapons against protestors. The attacks carried out by the regime government are in clear violation of international law and norms. Among a coalition of nations, the Republik shall take all measures necessary, both militarily and economically, to pressure the IRM government to accede to the ultimatum presented by Wuloosya. 

[b]Hochdeutsche Armee on the Move[/b]

With the conflict escalating quickly in the Imperium, the HDF had begun to carry out intelligence-gathering operations. RC-135 aircraft listened into IRM military transmissions, SAR satellites carried out identification and location of air defense systems and other installations, while AU-11J stealth drones began to take passes above the country to carry out surveillance missions. Using the information gathered, in the early morning, the HAF would begin to carry out the dismantling of Imperium air defenses. Vectis CCAs guided by J-15s would begin to carry out strikes against Imperium air defense systems. Using anti-radiation missiles, the AARGMs would quickly close in with radiation signals emitted by the enemy's air defense. MALD drones launched by the J-16s would both emit false aircraft signatures as well as begin the jamming of IRM communications to break down coordination. 

From Hochbayern-Eisenmark AFB, MC-20A drones would begin to carry out kinetic strike missions against targets. Using JDAM guided munitions and Paveway laser-guided bombs, the drones target command centers, arms depots, early warning radar, and missile launchers. KV one-way attack drones are deployed in the hundreds in the attack in conjunction with the suppression of air defenses with the purpose of saturating IRM air defenses as well as hitting critical military infrastructure. Klinge 200 autonomous drones are also deployed from the southern Republik into the IRM with the purpose of hunting radar emissions and diving onto them with their warheads. In Hochbayern in the south of the Republik, the 82nd Airborne Division is joined by the 22nd and 57th Airborne to begin preparations for missions into the IRM.
